notes: rk-io5l, ported from campaign C's record-integrity oracle (../rk-campaign-C/scripts/oracle-record-integrity.py:45-55, which required a banked claim to name a hash-bound record). Everything about this record is independent and well formed EXCEPT that it binds to no bytes: it therefore backs every future revision of the shard as strongly as the one actually reviewed, and can never be shown stale. Route (ii) — the L5 verdict store — has bound verdicts to shard bytes since M3.7; this is route (i) reaching the same bar.
